If a person is deprived of a male issue as a result of malevolence of planets at birth, he will be blessed with a son if he undertakes the following remedial measures- (1) Worshipping lord Shiva if the harm is as a result of the malevolence of Mercury and Venus, (2) Reciting of Santan Gopal mantra, wearing and worshipping appropriate yantra and taking suitable medicines, if the childlessness is a result of the malevolence of Jupiter and the Moon, (3) Kanyadana if the childlessness is due to malevolence of Rahu, (4) Worshipping of lord Vishnu if it is due to malevolence of the Sun, (5) Rudriya Japa if it is due to the malevolence of Mars and Saturn, Listening with devotion to Haribansh Purana removes all kinds of blemishes (दोष) and blesses the person concerned with a son.
